name: career
description: Career material for the French tech market, built once and projected per target. career-evidence keeps a versioned referential of engagements (missions, audits, training) where every client name carries its own disclosure level; cv-tailor projects it into a two-page ATS-safe CV or an ESN-style dossier de compétences; linkedin-profile audits and rewrites the profile for how LinkedIn Recruiter actually retrieves and ranks. Rules are sourced from vendor documentation (Workday, Greenhouse, Ashby, Apec, LinkedIn Engineering), never from resume-industry folklore.
